title: The Ugly Duckling
description: A young bird who never seems to fit in leaves the farmyard behind and survives a long winter before discovering what he was becoming all along.
catalogueBlurb: A lonely young bird crosses the seasons and discovers who he really is.
author: Hans Christian Andersen, retold by Quill
